speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) whether he can provide an update on the shutting down of train lines for scheduled maintenance; (b) how much additional work has been done during this period; and (c) how many man hours of effort have been achieved during this time.

speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: Meanwhile, we would like to thank commuters for their patience and understanding as we strive to improve our rail reliability.

speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Nee Soon)
text: I have been speaking to many Singaporeans, not just in my constituency, about how they feel about the scheduled maintenance.

speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Nee Soon)
text: So far, the feedback has been that it is a reasonable tradeoff.

speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Nee Soon)
text: Of course, maintenance is difficult, but if it is scheduled over the weekends or on public holidays, it is manageable.

speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Nee Soon)
text: My question is, in view of the excellent progress we have made, would the Ministry continue with this approach or even increase the frequency, so that we can upgrade our system even faster?

speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
text: I would convey it to our workers on the ground for those positive comments.

speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
text: Buses and other alternatives would be made available to commuters.
